hypothesis.title: Fear Spikes and Next-Week Returns: Does an Elevated VIX Predict Higher US Equity Returns?
hypothesis.statement: A VIX level that is high relative to its 60-day history predicts a higher S&P 500 return over the next five sessions.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The slope of the 5-day-ahead S&P 500 log return on the 60-day VIX z-score is zero.
hypothesis.alt_hypothesis: The slope is positive (HAC one-sided p < 0.05 and circular-shift placebo p < 0.05).
hypothesis.methodology: Overlapping-horizon predictive regression with Newey-West HAC errors and circular-shift placebo
hypothesis.metric_name: slope of 5d forward return on VIX z-score
